content.short: Snapshot is a gasless decentralized voting protocol for DAOs.
content.description: Snapshot is an open-source tool designed for organisations, especially decentralized ones, to improve the quality of their voting and proposal processes. Votes are conducted off the blockchain and verified on-chain, providing a clear record of governance decisions. The tool supports a range of voting methods, including quadratic voting and approval voting, enabling communities to tailor their decision-making to their needs.
